name: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk
summary: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk develops, owns, and operates hotels and resorts in Indonesia. It also develops shopping centers, entertainment centers, apartments, and mixed-use properties. In addition, the company is involved in the real estate, general trading, and development businesses; and playground or amusement or playing park activities. The company was formerly known as PT Penta Karsa Lubrindo and changed its name to PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk in 2004. PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
